name: myvoices-tts
description: Voice synthesis for streaming. Cloned voices, presets and saved phrases via XTTSv2, Piper, F5-TTS and Chatterbox. Requires the MyVoices desktop app to be running.
long_description: MyVoices integrates four TTS engines with voice cloning and a REST/MCP API. This extension connects Claude Desktop to a locally-running MyVoices instance using the bundled stdio MCP server (mcp_server.py), which forwards all calls to the local HTTP API. No internet connection required.
